author: U. Ghia, K. N. Ghia and C. T. Shin
title: High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method
review_scope: Original PDF rendered and visually read:391–392 equations/Fig1;398–399 TablesI/II Re100 columns;408 TableV primary vortex. Publisher abstract/bibliography read; publisher PDF403. Original PDF obtained from recorded public mirror; no full-paper audit.

review.ja: 原著の式・境界図・表I/IIのRe100列と表Vの主渦を直接目視確認。公開ミラーは原著の配送元として記録し、論文PDFは配布しません。本実装は原著のCSI-MG法とは異なります。
review.en: Visually inspected original equations/boundary figure, Re100 columns in TablesI/II and primary vortex in TableV. The public mirror delivers the original paper; its PDF is not redistributed. This independently written solver differs from CSI-MG.

author: Kambiz Salari and Patrick Knupp
title: Code Verification by the Method of Manufactured Solutions
review_scope: Official Sandia/OSTI record and primary report printed12 at UNT read for MMS plus mesh refinement. No whole-report audit. Our quartic polynomial and pressure field are newly constructed.

review.ja: Sandia/OSTI公式書誌・抄録と、原著報告の印刷12頁で製造解と格子細分化の併用を確認。本例の多項式と圧力場は独自に構成しました。
review.en: Read official Sandia/OSTI metadata/abstract and original report printed12 on MMS together with mesh refinement. The polynomial and pressure field are constructed for this example.
